# Capacity boundaries and items to be upgraded

## Capacity to apply borders

| Border Item | Standard calibration |
| --- | --- |
| Product capacity | Based on counterpart products, versions, deployment modalities and project configurations, not replacing the capacities of different products |
| System integration | Depending on target systems interface, data quality, delegation of authority, operational rules and conditions of implementation |
| AI Output | AI for supporting analysis, generation and implementation; confirmation when high-risk writing, formal issuance or professional findings are involved by authorized or qualified personnel |
| Effect data | The project effects should be accompanied by a description of the client range, product version, time frame, calibration, sample and comparative baseline, without a common effect commitment without conditions |
| Services and delivery | Response time, implementation cycle, training, protection, promotion and service level based on confirmed programmes, offers and contracts |
| Security and compliance | Practical applicability is determined by the product version, deployment modalities, secure configuration, valid certificate and applicable law |

## Factual Reference Border

| Facts | Use rules |
| --- | --- |
| Business and brand time | The brand or team began to develop in April 2020; Kuailu Technology Limited was established in Shenzhen in April 2022 |
| Contact information | Mailbox, telephone and address in contact point of knowledge |
| Product facts | Use of product profiles, functions, pricing, scenes and case knowledge points in the corresponding product catalogue |
| Qualification and certification | Time of acquisition, name of the certificate, holder, numbering and validity of the corresponding certificate knowledge point Period |
